notes: A new folder, as in /api/folders; only admins see it until people are given it. Its directory on the drive is its name, made safe for file systems, with a number when taken: <storage_dir>/Wedding Anna & Marco. The name is 1 to 60 characters and can't look like a date (2026-09-27), else 400 bad_request; 409 folder_name_taken if another folder has it, ignoring case. Once there is a root (GET /api/keys: roots), the admin's device picks the folder's id (a UUID in small letters; 409 folder_name_taken also for an id that is taken) and brings the root's signature of it: plain_signature, its plain statement for version 0 and its name as the server cleans it (spaces at the ends, control characters and more than 60 characters go), or key, its key's first version as in PUT /api/folders/{id}/encryption, which makes it encrypted. 400 bad_signature without either, or for one that doesn't verify; 409 no_key for key before the first recovery key. Before it, neither.
